description:
The Open Source Alternative To Notion.

AppFlowy is an open source alternative to Notion.
You are in charge of your data and customizations.
### 🚀 v0.14.8

#### New Features

• **Conditional formula styling** — Added colors, highlights, and text formatting through `style()` and `unstyle()` to highlight results based on formula conditions. Displayed the formatting in database cells and formula previews.
• **Simple table conversion** — Added actions to turn simple tables into databases or text, with undo and redo support.

#### Improvements

• **Cloud database loading** — Opened database views while rows loaded in the background and reused downloaded rows when reopening. Added automatic recovery notices while waiting for a busy server, plus clearer load errors with retry and error-copying actions.

#### Bug Fixes

• Fixed missing or stale database rows during loading and restore recovery, and preserved visible rows while a refresh was still loading.
• Fixed sidebar space selection when opening database rows from mention notifications or switching tabs, without redirecting to the space's default page.
• Fixed page duplication failures caused by delayed source synchronization or newly created database rows.
• Fixed simple-table alignment, undo and redo after deleting tables, and scrolling when adding rows to wide tables.
